title: TIC Solutions Reports Results for the Second Quarter 2026
summary: - Delivered strong second quarter revenue of $584.3 million - - Reported net loss of $13.3 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $94.8 million - - Achieved record combined Consulting Engineering and Geospatial backlog of $1.18 billion, up 20% YoY - - Reaffirms full-year 2026 outlook - TIC Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: TIC) (“TIC Solutions” or the “Company”), a leading provider of tech-enabled asset integrity, engineering, and geospatial services, today reported its financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The Company’s second quarter 2026 results include the financial performance of NV5 Global, Inc. (“NV5”) for the period following our acquisition of NV5 on August 4, 2025 (the “NV5 Acquisition”). All periods prior to August 4, 2025 reflect legacy Acuren results only and therefore exclude any contribution from NV5 which materially affected year-over-year comparability of our financial results for the periods presented.
